Question
========
On the classical capacity graph, the maximum number of requests per second is plotted against the amount of resources given to the problem. A dashed straight line extends the initial linear part of the curve.

What is the name of that dashed line?


Answerlist
----------
* Nominal capacity
* Useable capacity
* Knee capacity
* Total capacity

Solution
========
The dashed line is the ideal, linear scaling the system would reach in perfect conditions. That is the nominal capacity.

Answerlist
----------
* 1. It is the maximum throughput achievable in ideal conditions, i.e. perfect linear scaling.
* 0. The useable capacity is the throughput still respecting a response time bound, not the ideal line.
* 0. The knee is a point on the real curve where the gain starts to decrease, not the ideal line.
* 0. This is not one of the capacity definitions seen in the course.
